correctness.rationale: For the exact eventual Hall quantile, exponential order-statistic spacings give an exact decomposition. The correction expectation is \(m(z)=-\beta z/(1+\beta)+\beta z^2/(1+2\beta)+O(z^3)\); subtracting the first-order bias leaves \(\alpha A(n/k)^2/[\beta(1+2\beta)]\). Threshold and centered-correction errors are exponentially negligible at speed \(k\delta_n^2\), after which the gamma moderate-deviation law gives the exponent.
